notes.it: Materiali online uniformati alla biblioteca offline: caratteri, rientri, nomi cliccabili e hover. Internal Medicine: 4 CFU/40 ore dal piano di studi, Geriatrics 3 CFU/30 ore e Rehabilitation 1 CFU/10 ore; syllabus PDF ancora in attesa. Solo macOS.
notes.en: Online materials now match the offline library typography, indentation, clickable names and hover. Internal Medicine uses the study plan: 4 ECTS/40 hours total, Geriatrics 3/30 and Rehabilitation 1/10; syllabus PDF pending. macOS only.
